installation: Candidate bun.lock, bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts; main/node_modules linked to it before prepare or model calls.
digestMethod: JSON array sorted by relative path, each entry [path, file, SHA256] or [path, symlink, link target], compact UTF-8 JSON.
scope: The model comparison controls dependency runtime by sharing the candidate dependency tree. It is not an independent locked-dependency installation proof for each source tree. Separate packaged-host tests used their independently built artifacts.
